known_facts_book1: An old woman who lives in the Emerald City, spoken about only by the Tin Woodman; she never appears in person.
Inherited the crooked Sorcerer's possessions, including a bottle of the Powder of Life she mistook for moth-powder.
Accidentally brought her blue bear-skin rug to life by sprinkling the Powder on it and wishing her dear bear alive again.
Is troubled by the living Blue Bear Rug, which will not stay flat to be walked upon.
Her Blue Bear Rug (not Dyna herself) appears in the birthday procession, walking before Ozma.

known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: Tells the shaggy man her story; the two never meet on the page.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: Owns the Blue Bear Rug that flops down for Ozma to stand upon in the procession, though Dyna herself is absent.

known_facts_book1: Named only in backstory; the Nome King never appears, never speaks, and meets no one in this book.
Is remembered as the enemy from whom Dorothy once captured the Magic Belt she now leaves with Ozma.
Is remembered as the tyrant who once enslaved the Queen of Ev and her ten children until Ozma's people rescued them.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Her past adversary, from whom she captured the Magic Belt before this story; they do not meet here.
known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: His former captive, freed from him in an earlier adventure recalled at the party.
